r2_1.decision: R2-1 NOT SUPPORTED — CLOSE FALLBACK REPRESENTATION DIRECTION

dominant_remaining_mechanism: Exact-token BM25 cannot bridge user Latin query strings to Method D (or R2-1) document strings for ROOM/ENT; candidate generation fails. This is matching granularity / lexical identity, not Top-5 ranking and not kya/kiya normalization.

selected_next_hypothesis.name: Character 3-gram matching on frozen Method D tokens
selected_next_hypothesis.hypothesis: If exact token identity is the dominant remaining cause of ROOM/ENT candidate-generation failure, then representing frozen Method D tokens (and the unchanged query tokens) as pre-registered character 3-grams, scored with the same BM25 k1/b and Top-50, will increase ExactSource Hit@50 on R2-C0 ROOM Category 1 without changing the Method D romanizer, dictionary, tokenizer, routing, or gold labels.
selected_next_hypothesis.eligible_population: All Roman KN TRAIN+DEV queries (n=51). Primary slice = R2-C0 ROOM Category 1 (n=11 IDs frozen from r2_c0 cand_cat==1).
selected_next_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: ExactSource Hit@50 on the 11 ROOM Category 1 queries
selected_next_hypothesis.mandatory_confirmatory_reporting: Hit@1/5/10/50 and MRR on all 51 Roman KN TRAIN+DEV; do not headline the slice alone
selected_next_hypothesis.stop_criterion: If ROOM Category 1 Hit@50 remains 0/11, declare R2-NG3 unsupported and close remaining Roman lexical-matching work (do not add fuzzy, dense, or dictionary expansion in the same experiment).

final_decision: NEXT EXPERIMENT JUSTIFIED — R2-NG3 CHARACTER 3-GRAM MATCHING
